name: Ayu Mayu Alternative
original_name: アユマユ オルタネイティヴ
source:
Ayu Mayu Alternative is mainly about the events taking place around [url=/c37397]Daikuuji Ayu[/url] and [url=/c37396]Tamano Mayu[/url], the two waitresses from Sky Temple.

It is inspired by the anime Ayu Mayu Gekijou which had its fourth episode as a parody of Muv-Luv Alternative.
